detail.command:
set -e
printf '\n# Build artifacts\ndist/\n*.tsbuildinfo\n' >> .gitignore
rm -rf dist tsconfig.app.tsbuildinfo tsconfig.node.tsbuildinfo
printf '%s\n' '=== STATUS BEFORE PUBLISH ==='
git status --short
printf '%s\n' '=== IGNORE CHECK ==='
git check-ignore dist/ tsconfig.app.tsbuildinfo tsconfig.node.tsbuildinfo || true
